gacha._items: 宝物 are cards like in Rance X: each belongs to one troop's unit (relics.*.troop; lord = the lord's own), never as its leader, any number; worn ones work while that unit is out, or leave them in the pool
gacha._lap: 周目: a new playthrough keeps every card as it is; generals you have ever had (even story-only ones) join the recruit pool
gacha._rarity_mult: a card's whole stat line (troop base + its own bonus) × this, so a general clearly outclasses a soldier of the same troop
gacha._chest_chance: after a normal fight: chest_base + chest_overkill × overkill (100% overkill = certain) + 宝物/天命 chest bonus; bosses and elites always drop
gacha._chest_general: each card in a chest (treasure squares and after battles) may be a general instead of a soldier: base + per_level × (难度 - 1)
gacha._tiers: generals can be drawn again: copies needed for each tier (铜/银/金) and the multiplier on the general's own stats
gacha._merit: 战功: earned at the end of each chapter (per battle won, extra per boss/elite beaten), kept across chapters, spent in the recap

_enemy_moves: enemy move fields: power (× attack; 0 = no hit), weight (0 = only after a charge), confuse, rage (attack up for good), heal (share of its HP), ap_drain (AP taken next round), burn_party {share of party HP per turn, turns}, pierce (ignores guard and defend), charge (spends the turn winding up: next turn opens with that move), when: half (only below half HP), once. card: its card, which the chest after beating it may hold (enemy_card_chance, bosses and elites enemy_card_chance_boss)

battle._danger: 险: each accepted risk makes the rest of the run's enemies this much stronger (HP and attack)
battle._difficulty: 难度: permanent (whole campaign) enemy strength per level, e.g. after beating 虎牢关 吕布
battle._affixes: 词缀: every elite / boss square rolls one per run (shown on the map); hp / at are shares, resists add, actions adds, regen heals that share of max HP each enemy turn

_relics: 宝物: kept for one run (a chapter attempt). rarity: common / rare / curse (strong with a cost). mods: at, magic, heal, hp, guard (damage taken cut), combo (extra per combo step), desperate (attack when below half HP), ap_start, ap_round, ap_max, turns, start_heal, boost_start, stun_start, calm, no_ambush, chest, offer_extra, pierce (ignore resists), first_hit (first hit each battle), defend (extra defend cut), stun (confuse chance), troop_at / troop_hp {troop: share} (Rance X faction items), troop_cost {troop: AP off each skill, min 1}; after_win: heal this share of HP after every win
_fates: 天命: every run of a chapter starts by picking one of fate_offer fates; its mods (same keys as relics) last the run. common = 吉, rare = 大吉, curse = double-edged
